failed_endpoints.name: exact_issue_replay_is_idempotent
failed_endpoints.observation: An exact replay of generation 1 was rejected instead of returning the already committed checkpoint.
failed_endpoints.root_cause: The issue path evaluates predecessor/genesis admission before resolving an existing identical issuance, causing GENESIS_AFTER_EXISTING_STATE on an otherwise valid exact replay.

failed_endpoints.name: postcommit_response_loss_restarts_as_same_idempotent_checkpoint
failed_endpoints.observation: After the authority committed and the response was lost, a fresh authority process rejected the exact retry with GENESIS_AFTER_EXISTING_STATE.
failed_endpoints.root_cause: Same replay-ordering mechanism defect as P10-09: exact durable replay is checked too late.

failed_endpoints.name: authority_store_tamper_or_deletion_blocks_verification
failed_endpoints.observation: Verification remained positive after statement_json in the durable authority store was tampered while digest/tag columns remained unchanged.
failed_endpoints.root_cause: Verification checks stored digest/tag/issuance columns but does not parse and compare the durable statement_json to the supplied signed statement, leaving a durable-record integrity blind spot.

repair_scope: Resolve exact existing issuance/generation replay before predecessor/genesis admission while preserving semantic rebinding and same-generation equivocation denial.
Require the durable authority-store statement_json to parse and exactly match the supplied signed statement and its digest before verification can pass.
prohibited_repairs: Do not weaken or delete P10-09, P10-17, or P10-18.
Do not alter expected outcomes to make the run green.
Do not broaden model, reviewer, production, or release authority.
notes: Workflow failure is not itself the scientific finding; the finding is the three executed falsification endpoints that exposed mechanism behavior. A later repaired pass must retain this first-run failure in lineage and must not be described as first-run 20/20.
